WHY IT MATTERS

A switch for selected cells

Microbial opsins can be genetically placed in defined neurons. Carefully timed light then activates or inhibits those cells, letting researchers test causal links between circuit activity and behavior.

Verified source ↗
INPUTOpsin expression + wavelength + pulse
PROCESSPhoton-gated ion flow changes membrane potential
OUTPUTCell activity and downstream circuit behavior
